title: Encoder descriptor fallback target helper
summary: Add descriptor-owned CPU fallback target resolution for encoder families without wiring it into active Do-Encode fallback behavior.
reason: Encoder breadth activation needs a family-consistent fallback target before Do-Encode can replace hardcoded libx265 fallback events and plan arguments. This slice adds the resolver and coverage while preserving current active command behavior.
behavior_before: Dormant descriptors and synthetic runtime checks existed, but the descriptor layer had no reusable helper that mapped an encoder codec to its family-specific CPU fallback descriptor or reported HDR blocking before future fallback activation work.
behavior_after: The descriptor layer can resolve codec names to encoder families and return a structured CPU fallback target for HEVC, H.264, and AV1. HDR inputs fail closed for fallback descriptors that do not claim HDR10 preservation. The active resolver and Do-Encode path remain unchanged.
